title: A collectible lookup answer or error is applied to whichever lookup is open, not the one that asked
trigger: Tap a collectible username/phone row on profile A, then before the answer arrives tap one on profile B (second tap replaces hub.collectible and sends a second request). A's answer (or COLLECTIBLE_NOT_FOUND) lands.
effect: The box for B shows A's purchase date and price under B's name and owner; or A's not-found error marks B failed, so B's link is copied and its real answer is dropped. Applies by purpose only (state/domains/payments/apply.rs:25, error.rs:64); CollectibleLookup holds no request id.
fix: Make the lookup an enum Loading{request: RequestId} / Ready(info) / Failed(reason) and apply an answer or error only when its extra equals the Loading request id.

title: CollectibleLookup stage is loading: bool + info: Option + failed: Option kept in step by hand
trigger: Open a collectible box; the answer sets loading=false and info, an error sets loading=false and failed.
effect: Today all three can be set together or none (request lost leaves loading=true so a repeat tap on the same entity returns Ok(None) and never re-sends; request_collectible_info in connect/payments.rs:293 checks open.loading).
fix: Fetch<CollectibleInfo> (idle/loading/ready/failed) with the request id in the loading variant.

title: Calls 'Clear all' stage is recent_calls_clearing: bool beside recent_calls_request and recent_calls_error
trigger: Open the Calls tab, press Clear all, confirm; while in flight the button hides via can_clear(len, clearing).
effect: Stage is a bool set after send (connect/calls/history.rs:190) and cleared by hand in session_apply_ok.rs:63 and calls/error.rs:92, not matched to the request id; fetch_call_history can clear the list while clearing is true. No bug found today.
fix: One enum for the recent-calls list: Idle/Loading{request}/Ready/Failed/Clearing{request}; can_clear takes the enum.

title: Pasted clipboard images are written to a guessable world-readable temp file that is never deleted
trigger: Paste an image into the composer (or export a peer QR through the same helper), send or discard it, keep using Quill.
effect: The image bytes stay in the system temp dir as quill-paste-<nanos>-<seq>-<pid>.<ext> (default umask, usually readable by other local users) until the OS clears temp; the startup sweep in scratch.rs only covers the quill-send-photos/quill-edits... subfolders, not these files. A guessable name in a shared temp dir is also open to a pre-placed symlink.
fix: Write into the swept per-process work dir (scratch) with create_new and mode 0600, and delete the file when the tray entry is sent, removed or the app exits.

title: A deferred caption for a pending media message is never dropped if the pending message is deleted or cancelled
trigger: Send a photo, press Up to edit the caption while it is uploading, then delete/cancel the pending message so no updateMessageSendSucceeded or Failed arrives for it.
effect: The DeferredCaption stays in session.messages.deferred_captions for the life of the account (only run_deferred_caption on a send outcome removes it). Small leak; no wrong send since temp ids are not reused.
fix: Drop deferred captions in the message-delete reducer, or keep the caption on the pending message row as a PendingSend::CaptionEdited variant so it dies with the row.

title: Birthday suggestion dismissal is an optimistic birthdays_hidden bool reverted by hand
trigger: Dismiss the birthday card: connect/privacy_data.rs:255 sets birthdays_hidden=true after sending; HideContactCloseBirthdays error resets it (session_privacy_data.rs:182); updateContactCloseBirthdays resets it (settings/apply.rs:262).
effect: Works today, but the stage (shown / hiding / hidden) is a bool plus a reset rule in three places, not matched to the dismiss request.
fix: enum BirthdayCard {Shown, Hiding{request}, Hidden} and apply the error only for that request id.

title: A released swipe re-resolves its action when it fires, so a chat state change in the 150 ms spring-back flips the action
trigger: Swipe a row past the threshold with Mute configured while the chat is unmuted, release; another device (or a sync) mutes the chat within 150 ms.
effect: poll() returns only the chat id; chat_swipe_ui.rs:290 perform_swipe_action recomputes the label from current facts, so the action run is Unmute while the panel showed Mute. Tiny window.
fix: Store the resolved SwipeLabel in Release and fire exactly that action.

title: SwipeMachine holds gesture: Option and releases: Vec plus per-gesture direction_set/reached bools
trigger: Trackpad swipe on a chat row.
effect: Explicit machine, tested; Gesture uses direction_set + orientation + reached bools stepped by hand, and the app keeps a poll: Option<Task> as a 'timer running' flag (ui/chat_swipe_ui.rs:36). No bug found: state lives in OnScreen.chat_list and its task is spawn_screen.
fix: Fold direction_set into Orientation::Undecided{no_direction}/..., and make the poll task part of the machine state.

title: Level tap error closes the source but leaves 'speaking' true and never sends is_speaking=false
trigger: Join a group call, unmute and talk, then unplug or lose the microphone so source.error() returns Some
effect: pump_call_audio closes the tap and returns early; speaking and the tracker are not reset, deadline() returns None (no source), and the open retry path (line 344) returns Ok(false) too, so the self tile keeps showing 'speaking' and TDLib is never told false until a reopen succeeds or the call is muted
fix: Route the error arm through the same 'cannot speak' teardown as the wanted==None arm (reset tracker, send false), or make the tap one enum (Closed, Opening, Open{speaking}, Failed{at,error}).

title: CallAudio is a hand-kept machine: source/opening/injected/injected_open/failed_at/error/speaking/read_at
trigger: Any group call with the microphone level tap
effect: Fields must change together (open sets source+clears opening/failed_at/error; close clears opening/read_at but not speaking)
fix: enum Tap { Closed, Opening(Receiver), Open{source, read_at, speaking}, Failed{at, error} }.

title: CallCapture: active Option + failed_at + error kept in step by hand
trigger: Open, lose, and reopen the call microphone
effect: active is None/Opening/Running (DeviceRun) while failed_at and error are separate Options cleared in finish_open and when wanted==None
fix: enum Mic { Off, Active(ActiveCapture), Failed{at, error} }.

title: Screen share spread over chosen/with_audio/active/error here and screen_sharing/screen_share_pending/screen_share_paused in the session
trigger: Pick a source, share, pause by hiding the window, stop
effect: Driver and session each hold part of one share; resets are repeated at four sites (stale, Ended, finish_open Err, wanted none)
fix: enum Share { None, Chosen{source,audio}, Opening, Running{..}, Ended{error} } owned by the driver, session flags derived from it.

title: Share wanted and source chosen but no frame sender: stays 'sharing' with nothing sent and no error
trigger: Start screen share in a call whose engine is unavailable or has not created external sources (external_frame_sender returns None)
effect: pump_shared_screen returns silently every pump; the session says screen_sharing, the call window shows the share as live, but no capture is opened and call_screen.error is never set
fix: Waiting-for-engine as an explicit Share stage with a timeout/error that ends the share via stop_sharing_screen.

title: Failed screen-pause toggle is never retried and shows a generic voice chat error
trigger: Share a window in a group call, hide it (pause edge), toggleGroupCallScreenSharingIsPaused fails
effect: set_screen_paused already stored active.paused/call.screen_share_paused; the request uses the ToggleGroupCallVideo purpose so the error arm only sets group_call_error 'Voice chat request failed'; later pumps see no edge, so the server keeps showing the share unpaused
fix: Own purpose for the pause toggle whose error arm reverts the flag, or resend while server and local state differ.

title: rating_sent is set before the answer and the SendCallRating error arm never clears it
trigger: End a call, rate it, TDLib sendCallRating fails (offline, flood)
effect: summary.rating_sent stays true so the rating card is gone (call_ui hides on rating_sent) and send_call_rating refuses; only a calls.error line shows; the rating cannot be retried
fix: Rating as enum Rating{Asking, Sending(RequestId), Sent}; the error arm returns to Asking (as SendCallLog does for log_sent).

title: send_call_log has no in-flight guard and does blocking file IO on the UI thread; stale log file left
trigger: Click 'upload call log' twice quickly
effect: Two sendCallLog requests are sent (log_sent only becomes true on ok) and call-<id>.log is written synchronously under exports each time
fix: CallLog stage enum (Idle, Sending(RequestId), Sent, Failed) checked before the write.

title: Recent calls list is a hand-made Fetch: recent_calls + offset + error bool + request Option + clearing bool
trigger: Open Recent calls, page, clear all, switch tabs
effect: fetch_call_history resets four fields by hand; recent_calls_clearing is a stage bool cleared only on ok/error
fix: Fetch<Paged<Call>> plus a Clearing(RequestId) variant.

title: Call privacy: privacy_pending counter + privacy_error + optimistic Options
trigger: Open call privacy settings and change a rule while the first fetch is in flight
effect: fetch/set error paths zero privacy_pending while other requests are still in flight (answers then decrement saturating); a failed set clears the optimistic value to None with nothing refetching it
fix: Per-setting Fetch<PrivacyWho> with optimistic Saving{previous,new} variant.

title: maybe_finish_leave_deletes takes the whole queue and drops the rest on the first error
trigger: Delete and leave several basic groups; leaveChat answers; the first removeChatFromList send returns Err (chats path inactive or native send failure)
effect: delete_after_leave was emptied with mem::take and `?` returns, so the failing chat and all later ones are never deleted: the group is left but stays in the chat list
fix: Peek/drain one at a time, or put unsent chat ids back on error (as maybe_finish_folder_removals does).

title: reorderChatFolders and toggleChatFolderTags are applied optimistically with no rollback and no error arm
trigger: Drag a folder tab / flip folder tags while TDLib refuses or errors
effect: apply_folder_order / are_folder_tags_enabled stay at the refused value (no PendingRequest.rollback set, no arm in chat_list/error.rs) and no error line shows, until a later updateChatFolders
fix: Attach RequestRollback::{FolderOrder, FolderTags} like ChatPinOrder and add error arms.

title: Remove-from-folder chain: folder_remove_queue + folder_specs + folder_specs_stale + in-flight EditChatFolder/GetChatFolder
trigger: Remove a chat from a folder twice in a row, or while an edit is in flight
effect: Queue intent, fetch spec, edit, mark stale is a four-step machine kept by purpose lookups; a chat missing from session.chats is skipped (continue) yet counted as removed
fix: Per-folder enum FolderEdit{Queued(chats), FetchingSpec, Editing(RequestId)}.

title: archive_settings_loading bool beside archive_chat_list_settings Option
trigger: Open archive settings; fetch fails
effect: Loading is a bool kept in step with the cached Option and cleared in apply and error arms
fix: Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings>.

title: select_chat_open sets session.open_chat before send_open_chat; a send error leaves the chat 'open' without openChat
trigger: Select a chat while the TDLib send fails once (native error)
effect: `?` returns Err but session.open_chat is set; re-selecting the same chat takes the 'already open' branch (line 56) and never sends openChat, so TDLib does not deliver open-chat updates/read marks for it
fix: Open as a stage (Opening/Open) with the TDLib openChat result, or roll back open_chat on error. Same in open_chat_window (chat_window.rs:29).

title: deselect_chat returns early on a send error and leaves session.open_chat set after the main window cleared its chat
trigger: Move the open chat to its own window while cancel_outgoing_typing or closeChat fails to send
effect: `?` at lines 122-123 skips leave_open_chat, so the session still treats the chat as shown (chat_is_shown): new messages are auto-viewed/read while the main window shows nothing; draft_clock/pending_draft were not reset
fix: Do the local teardown first (leave_open_chat), then send the TDLib closes best-effort.

title: close_open_chat / send_open_chat / close_chat_window register a pending request and do not take it when the send fails
trigger: closeChat or openChat send returns Err
effect: session.request(..) entry stays in requests.pending for the life of the session (every other site calls requests.take(extra)); chat_window.rs:107, composer.rs:349 and :360
fix: Use the send-or-take helper (send_json_request) in these three sites.

title: A failed draft send leaves the slot marked dirty with nothing pending
trigger: Type in the composer; the debounced or flushed setChatDraftMessage send returns Err
effect: mark_draft_dirty ran, pending_draft/draft_clock were cleared before send_draft (Write arm line 117-119, commit_debounced_draft take()), the error is returned and dropped by callers; the slot stays dirty so drafts saved from other devices are ignored (per the deselect_chat comment) and the draft is never retried
fix: Keep the pending draft until send_draft succeeds (Draft stage: Clean, Dirty, Debouncing{token}, Sending).

title: Draft save pipeline: pending_draft Option + draft_clock + draft_save_token + session dirty flag
trigger: Type in two slots (main and a chat window)
effect: One save waits at a time; settle/flush/cancel paths each reset clock and pending by hand (seven sites)
fix: enum DraftSave { Idle, Waiting{slot, started, token, content}, Sending(RequestId) }.

title: One session-wide mention_search is searched against session.open_chat, shared by main and chat-window composers
trigger: Type '@x' in a chat window composer while the main window shows another group or no chat
effect: search_mentions uses session.open_chat (the main window's chat unless the caller entered the window view) and stores a single Option, so a window can show or clear the other window's suggestions
fix: Key the search by (window, chat) or store it in the window's ChatUi.

title: Contacts list: contacts Option + contacts_error bool + in-flight purpose
trigger: Open Contacts, add/delete a contact (list set to None) while offline
effect: refetch_invalidated_contacts re-derives loading from three places; a send failure sets contacts_error by hand
fix: Fetch<Vec<UserId>>.

title: Chat media counts: entry is inserted before six requests; a failed filter leaves a zero count forever
trigger: Open the info panel; one getChatMessageCount fails
effect: chat_media_counts[chat] is inserted as default and never re-asked ('once per chat per session'); the failing filter shows 0
fix: Per-filter Fetch<i32> that retries on reopen.

title: Failed chat link delete keeps the row removed from the list
trigger: Delete a business chat link; deleteBusinessChatLink fails
effect: delete_chat_link removes the row optimistically; the error arm (business_extra.rs MutateChatLink) only sets the error text for Delete (no saving decrement, no re-ask: chat_links_requested stays true), so the link is hidden though it still exists
fix: Rollback of the removed row, or reset chat_links_requested in the Delete error arm so the list is asked again.

title: lookup_business_bot records the query before the sends; a failed second/third send leaves it unresolved for the same text
trigger: Type a bot username while mine/global send fails
effect: lookup.query is set, Exact sent, `?` returns on Mine; typing the same text again returns early at line 179, so mine/global stay None (loading) until the text changes
fix: Set lookup.query only after all three parts are sent, or mark failed parts.

title: Business page loads: chat_links_requested/connected_bot_requested bools, chat_links_saving counter, business.saving Vec, one shared business.error
trigger: Open Business pages, save several settings, one fails
effect: 'requested' bools are reset on error/ok by hand; every new save does `business.error = None`, wiping another save's error before it was seen
fix: Fetch<T> for links and bot; per-kind Saving/Failed(error) map instead of one error string.

title: Time zones: time_zones Option + time_zones_requested bool; own info: user_full_infos presence + own_info_error + in-flight purpose
trigger: Open Business hours/location offline
effect: Stage derived from a bool plus an Option; reset on send error and TDLib error separately
fix: Fetch<Vec<TimeZone>> and Fetch<UserFullInfo>.

title: ClosingSet: close_held_until Option in the driver + restart bool + unconfirmed set; close_all_within/Drop block the calling thread
trigger: Quit or drop a ClosingSet while clients are closing
effect: close sent either at once or after a hold timer that only drain_bridged releases; a client unconfirmed stays blocked for the process; Drop sleeps up to 1.5 s on whichever thread drops the set
fix: enum Closing { Holding{until}, Sent, Closed, Lost } per client; keep the blocking wait to the quit path only.

title: 1:1 call media is driven by CallTransport enum plus call_devices_warmed bool, call_devices_listing Option, call_sound_watch Option, camera_on/screen_sharing/muted intent flags
trigger: Place a call, toggle camera and screen share before the transport exists
effect: Intent flags (camera_on, screen_sharing, muted) are stored on the call and replayed at connect; camera/screen share clear each other by hand (set_call_camera:337, set_call_screen_share:379) without telling the engine of the other track
fix: enum LocalVideo { Off, Camera, Screen } on the call.

title: ingest returns early with ? after the reducer took the pending request, dropping answers captured before apply
trigger: A link-preview, message-link, AI-compose, username-check or instant-view answer arrives in the same envelope while run_post_ingest_pumps, maybe_continue_boost, maybe_load_main_chats, maybe_load_archive_chats or sync_shown_views returns a send error (sender closed).
effect: The captured answer is never stashed: composer chip stays 'Getting link info', copy link / AI text / username verdict / instant view silently lost.
fix: Run the stash steps before any fallible step, or collect errors and return the first at the end as run_post_ingest_pumps does.

title: request_close restores shutdown on send failure but not the logout_request that begin_close cleared
trigger: A logOut is in flight (logout_request Some), then request_close is called and its send fails.
effect: shutdown goes back but auth_state.logout_request stays None, so TDLib's logOut answer is no longer matched.
fix: Make begin_close return an undo token or save/restore both fields together (one ShutdownPhase carrying the logout request).

title: maybe_send_parameters leaves the SetParameters pending entry when send_json fails
trigger: setTdlibParameters send fails (sender closed) on kickoff or an ingest; every later ingest registers another SetParameters request.
effect: Pending registry accumulates dead SetParameters entries until swept; parameters_sent bool shadows the WaitTdlibParameters stage.
fix: take(extra) on send failure like the other senders; derive 'sent' from the auth stage instead of a bool.

title: BatchState is open + three dirty bools + a waiting-file set kept in step by hand
trigger: Each envelope in a poll batch sets dirty flags; end_batch takes them and runs the passes.
effect: No bug today; end_batch takes the flag before the pass runs, so a send error in run_shown_media loses that pass until another update dirties it (S4).
fix: One enum Batch{Closed, Open{dirty: PassSet}} and take a pass only after it succeeded.

title: A finished deep-link flow (ShowText / ChatReady) blocks every later link until the UI consumes it
trigger: A launch link ends in ShowText or ChatReady while the surface that consumes it is not drawn (locked, window closed), then another tg:// link is opened.
effect: request_deep_link_info returns Ok(None) for each new link; links silently do nothing until the stale state is consumed.
fix: Let a new launch link replace any non-ResolvingInfo stage, or give every stage an owner window and a Farewell closer.

title: Deep-link flow keeps DeepLinkState plus a separate origin bool, original string and generation counter
trigger: request_deep_link_info / continue_deep_link / confirm_deep_link_invite each set several fields.
effect: No bug found; answers are matched by generation. deep_link_from_agent and deep_link_original live outside the enum and are overwritten on every start.
fix: Carry origin and original link inside the DeepLinkState variants.

title: resume_disk_paused_found takes the whole due list, then returns on the first toggle error
trigger: Several found paused downloads are due and the first toggle_download_paused send fails.
effect: The remaining ids were already mem::taken and are never resumed; save_disk_pauses_if_changed is skipped.
fix: Keep ids queued until each is sent, and always run the save step.

title: disk_resume_searched bool + disk_search_keys + SearchDiskPausedDownloads request + disk_resume_due form one search stage
trigger: Healthy disk with saved pauses starts the once-per-session search.
effect: No bug today (flag reset on send failure, but an error answer leaves it true by design).
fix: enum DiskSearch{Idle, Asked{keys}, Done}.

title: open_earn_page marks TON/Stars Loading then returns early on the first send error
trigger: Open a revenue page when a send fails (TonStats or StarStats, not only TonTransactions).
effect: page.ton / page.stars stay Load::Loading forever, later requests (stars history, ad account) are never sent.
fix: Mark Loading only per request after it is sent, or fail all marked loads on any send error.

title: fetch_earn_balances records the peer as asked before sending and an error answer never clears it
trigger: Open a channel/bot profile when the balance request fails (apply_earn_error ignores TonBalance/StarBalance) or the send fails.
effect: The balance row never loads again for that peer in this session; balances_asked only grows.
fix: Fetch<T> per peer balance (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) instead of a visited Vec.

title: Program-list answers are not keyed to the sort or request that asked them
trigger: In the affiliate join page change 'Sort by' twice quickly, or scroll for more while changing sort.
effect: SearchPrograms{for_box,append} is the only key: an older answer lands in the reset list (wrong order shown until the later answer; a stale append adds old-sort rows to the new list). fetch_found_programs also sends a second non-append page while one is loading.
fix: Carry a generation in SearchPrograms and in ProgramList, drop mismatched answers, and gate non-append starts on is_loading.

title: ConnectedPrograms answer is not keyed to the join page's peer
trigger: Open the join page for peer A, then for peer B before A's connected list answers.
effect: A's list is written into B's join.mine (replaced when B's own answer lands).
fix: Add peer/generation to the purpose and compare in the reducer.

title: Recipients load is recipients Option + recipients_loading counter + pending_join + join_box
trigger: open_bot_affiliate_join / open_affiliate_program ask two requests and park the join box until both answered.
effect: If the second send fails after the first went out, recipients_loading is reset to 0 while the first answer later fills recipients with a partial list (user + channels, no bots) that is then cached for the session (S4).
fix: enum Recipients{Idle, Loading{chats,bots}, Ready(Vec)} and a join box that carries its own wait.

title: Earn withdrawal / setup / join / revoke each hold stage flags beside Options
trigger: Collect/Withdraw, save program, join program, revoke link.
effect: Withdraw is matched by request id (waits_for) so no bug found; Password{sending:bool}, SetupPage.saving/confirm, EarnState.setup_closed, JoinBox.joining, Revoke.sending are stage bools.
fix: Make joining/sending part of the step enum (Idle/Sending{request}).

title: end_starref_program closes the confirmation (confirm = None) before the send can fail
trigger: Confirm 'End program' while the send fails.
effect: Confirmation box disappears as if ended; nothing was sent.
fix: Clear confirm only after the send succeeded.

title: status_open / chat_status_open are only cleared by the media panel mode setter on the current account
trigger: Open the emoji-status selector, then switch accounts (or lose the panel) without leaving Status mode through set_media_panel_mode.
effect: The old session keeps status_open=true, so every ingest of that background account keeps resolving status emoji (getCustomEmojiStickers) and a later failure writes status_note.
fix: Move the open flag into OnScreen/WindowSlot state and close it in the Farewell.

title: One shared emoji.failed bool is cleared by any emoji_set_request, hiding an earlier failure
trigger: A status change send fails (failed=true, status_note set), then another unrelated emoji pack request is sent.
effect: failed is reset to false by the unrelated request; the stage of the failed action is lost (status_note remains).
fix: Per-action Fetch<()> instead of a shared failed flag.

title: ensure_emoji_pack_covers marks covers requested before ensure_media_files succeeds
trigger: Open the pack browser when the media request send fails.
effect: Those set covers are never requested again.
fix: Insert into covers_requested only after the download request went out.

title: Emoji pack browser stage is open + tab + trending_offset + mutating_set + mutation_failed + search_query
trigger: Open the browser, switch tabs, install/remove a pack.
effect: No bug found; stale tab answers are dropped by take_purpose.
fix: enum EmojiBrowser{Closed, Open{tab, mutation: Idle|Changing|Failed}}.

title: pump_call_audio errors are mapped to 'changed' every poll
trigger: A group call is active and send_speaking keeps failing (sender closed).
effect: request_tick returns true every poll, forcing a redraw loop.
fix: Treat a send error as unchanged and surface it once.

title: Add-folder-by-link dialog is folder_invite_link + info + error + done + request
trigger: Open an addlist link: check_folder_invite_link resets four fields and sets request.
effect: If the send fails, link is Some with info/error None and no request: dialog shows no result and no error (S3 plausible).
fix: enum FolderInvite{Idle, Checking{link,request}, Ready{..}, Failed{..}, Adding{..}, Done}.

title: process_folder_new_chats removes the new-chats bar before the answer and nothing restores it on failure
trigger: Tap 'Add' or dismiss on the shared-folder new-chats bar and the request fails.
effect: The bar is gone, chats not joined, no error shown; fetch_folder_new_chats is also stamped once per period (asked is set before the send), so it does not come back for the period.
fix: Remove the bar on success only (or keep it Processing{request}) and stamp asked on answer.

title: Saved sublists: topics_requested/topics_exhausted bools, SavedTagSearch.request Option, history.loaded_complete
trigger: Open Saved Messages, scroll sublists, filter by tag.
effect: No bug found; topics_requested is reset on error and the tag request is matched by id.
fix: Fetch<Page> per list.

title: GIF panel stage is open + search_mode + search_loading + search_failed + loading + loaded + failed + stale
trigger: Open GIF panel, search, switch back to saved, bot username changes (core/mod.rs gif_bot_changed).
effect: No bug found; errors reset search_loading. The ingest loop re-calls maybe_search_gifs every envelope while search_loading is true.
fix: enum GifPanel{Saved(Fetch), Search{query, Fetch, next}}.

title: GIF search asks the inline bot with the main window's open chat, not the chat of the panel's window
trigger: Open the GIF panel in a chat window while the main window shows another chat (or none).
effect: getInlineQueryResults carries the wrong chat id (0 when none).
fix: Pass the asking window's chat into search_gifs.

title: open_send_gift_to replaces the whole send state while a sendGift is in flight
trigger: Press Send in the send-gift dialog, close the dialog (close_send_gift keeps sending=true), reopen the dialog for any user before the answer.
effect: SendGiftState is reset (sending=false, request=None), so the Send button is live again and the first answer is dropped by waits_for; a second Send spends Stars again and the first outcome is never shown.
fix: Refuse to open (or keep the in-flight purchase) while send is Sending{request}; model send as enum Idle/Sending/Done/Failed.

title: limits_asked is set before the limit requests and send failures are ignored; GetGiftCollections answers are not keyed by owner
trigger: Open a gifts list when the option sends fail; or open owner A's gifts then owner B's before A's collections answer.
effect: Limits are never asked again this session; A's collections can fill B's list until B's own answer lands.
fix: Carry the owner in the purpose and compare; Fetch<Limits>.

title: Gift management is gift_mutating + gifts_error + note, collections_loading/stale, export_unlocked and TransferStage::Password{sending}
trigger: Pin, upgrade, transfer, delete, export-to-Fragment.
effect: No bug found beyond the entry above; the reducer unlocks on the answer and settle_lost_request clears it.
fix: enum GiftMutation{Idle, InFlight{request, purpose}, Failed} and put export_unlocked into the transfer stage.

title: start_gift_resale_buy / open_gift_resale / open_gift_craft replace buy and craft sessions that have a request in flight
trigger: Start a purchase (buy.sending, Stars spent), then start another buy, open another resale list, or open the craft box before the answer.
effect: The old ResaleBuy/CraftSession is dropped: its answer is ignored (outcome unseen) and the new buy is not sending, so the user can pay twice.
fix: Refuse to replace while sending/crafting; make ResaleBuy a stage enum.

title: follow_gift_auction sets followed before the open request and never unfollows on logout or account switch
trigger: Open an auction box when the follow send fails; or leave the box open and switch accounts.
effect: followed = new id, so the retry returns early (updates never start); the old account stays subscribed to auction updates.
fix: Set followed after the send succeeds; close the follow in the owner's Farewell.

title: Gift market uses ResaleSearch loading/loaded/error, candidates_loading, auction_loading/ready/request, bidding, buy.sending, craft.crafting
trigger: Resale browsing, auctions, bidding, crafting.
effect: Answers are matched by stored request ids; no bug found beyond the replace case above.

title: GiftValueLookup is request + loading + info + error + open
trigger: Tap the Value row's learn more.
effect: No bug found; answers match lookup.request and another gift replaces the lookup.
fix: enum GiftValue{Loading{request}, Ready{info, open}, Failed}.

title: Giveaway options keep premium_loading/stars_loading with premium_error/stars_error pairs
trigger: Open the giveaway form for a channel.
effect: Both loading+error pairs can be set; an answer for an earlier boosted chat is not keyed (S3 plausible if the form is reopened for another channel).
fix: Fetch<Options> keyed by boosted chat.

title: AwardMembers has loading bool beside generation, offset and query
trigger: Search or scroll the 'Choose members' list.
effect: No bug found; answers are generation-matched.
fix: Fetch<Page> with generation inside.

title: grams_tick records asked_users/asked_chats even when the lookup send failed
trigger: Open My Grams while a peer lookup send fails.
effect: That peer is never asked again, its row keeps the bare id.
fix: Insert into the asked set only when the send succeeded.

title: My Grams page is open + loading + loaded + error + request + probed + peers_dirty
trigger: Open My Grams, switch All/Incoming/Outgoing.
effect: No bug found; restart replaces the request id.
fix: Fetch<TxPage> per filter.

title: Protected-content rollback restores the flag but not the private_sharing disabled record
trigger: In a private chat turn sharing off and the request fails.
effect: set_chat_protected(previous) restores the flag, but private_sharing.record_disabled stays, so the chat shows 'you disabled sharing' for an unchanged chat.
fix: Put the record into the rollback or record it on success only.

title: admin_followups are removed only when a real envelope answers; swept or settled requests keep them
trigger: A basic group upgrade or history toggle request is swept (stale TTL) or settled by logout while a followup is queued.
effect: The followup stays in groups.admin_followups forever and the chained step (link, topics, history) never runs and no error note appears.
fix: Drop and fail followups in settle_lost_request.
